content: Guguya

Boda madou hedada siꞌetoꞌautama ma sihetupa duidui, ma Yesu ꞌigwae nugeta ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya, ꞌigwaeya, “Waꞌita yahigomi ma Palisiyao ꞌidi paihowa ꞌaboꞌabo sahena wapaipaihowadi, weyahina ꞌidi paihowa gide tuwa pwalawa ꞌana ꞌebeꞌabi heseseha. Cebeꞌabi hesesehaina ꞌeguma toꞌaha gide ꞌiꞌiuna, nata ꞌiꞌabi hemadou,
ma ginaulaedi dahwadahwaidi ꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌiꞌabilatuhedi ma siloꞌatamanedi.
Ma wete toꞌaha guguyou ꞌoina wagwaeneya nata sabwelo ꞌoina tomota sihesagohe. Ma toꞌaha weyahina waheꞌahwa henahena hada ꞌalona, nata tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya sihepwaila latuhedi.
“Ma ꞌiyagwao yahegwaegomi, taudi wahimi siloheꞌamasi, sahena wamatamatautedi, weyahina taudi wahimimo sowasowahina ma siloheꞌamasi, ma yaluyaluwami geya.
Ma hesi Yehoba wamataute, weyahina tauna maꞌina loina ma ꞌiloheꞌamasa nugetegomi ma muliyetega ꞌiula suluhegomi ꞌasa ꞌalaꞌalata* ꞌoina. Moisa tuwa, ꞌiboinamo wamataute!
“Hisa gidemusa dinegwa ꞌadi maisa? Geya madouna, gidemusa toea ꞌeluwamo ma bwasumo nima ꞌaiꞌaigeda ꞌadi baibaiwa. Ma tuwa Yehoba geyaꞌabwa wete ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega ꞌinuwa nuwanaide.

Ma ꞌiyamo geya sowasowahina ma deba wahasili mwagu ꞌaigeda ꞌoina, Yehoba ꞌadi baibaiwa ꞌisanasanapudi. Coinega sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho, weyahina ꞌomi Yehoba ꞌina ginaula madouna, ma dinegwa geya ginaula madouna.
Yesu ꞌana hemisa ma ꞌana uhala weyahina
“Ma bewa wete wasanapu bwaibwaini: Ceguma taiyawedi weyahigu tomota matadiya sihepwaila, taugu Loheyaiguina nata weyahidi yada hepwaila Tamagu ꞌina aneloseyao matadiya.
Ma ꞌeguma taiyawedi siuhalegau tomota matadiya, taugu wete ꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌina aneloseyao matadiya yauhaledi.
Taugu Loheyaiguina, ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌiꞌahwa galegalegau, Yehoba nata gwaeina ꞌinuwasam. Ma ꞌeguma taiya Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiꞌahwa galegale, nata geyaꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌinuwanuwasam.
“Ma ꞌeguma tomota sitoegomi hada tapwalolo ꞌoidiya sabi heyatalaegomi babadao ta toloinao matadiya, sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho bo nuwana wanuwanuwatuhu togidega ꞌidi hesilalaina wahemaisa ꞌese,
weyahina ꞌabwa tutaina beno ꞌoina Yaluyaluwa Tabuna baꞌidamiu, ma nata tauna ꞌiheꞌitegomi toꞌaha wagwaene.”
Gwae hegehegedi wasawasa weyahina
Ma bodaedi ꞌoidiyega ꞌaigeda tomota ꞌigwaeya, “Toheꞌita, tasigu ꞌuhegwae ma tupwana ꞌebeloina ꞌiꞌebwaegau, mwalo tamamai ꞌilaguya.”
Ma Yesu loheyaina ꞌenana ꞌihemaiseya, ꞌigwae, “Loheya, taugu geya sowasowahigu ma yahetoloina ꞌami heguheguyaiina weyahina.”
Ma wete ꞌina gwaeina ꞌitubweya ma boda mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Waꞌitayahigomi ma sahena wasawasa nuwami ꞌiꞌewaꞌewa. Geya sowasowahina ma wasawasa ꞌoinega yawasimi bwebweꞌana waloba.”
Coinega ꞌebeꞌita ꞌiꞌebwaediya gwae hegehegediyega, ꞌigwaeya, “Caigeda tohewasawasa ꞌina tanoha madoudi ma baibaiwadi, ta ꞌeliꞌeli madouna ꞌoidiyega ꞌilobeya.
Eeta loheyaina ꞌiboinamo ꞌinuwatuhu dadana, ma ꞌigwaeya, ‘Celiꞌeli madouna ta ꞌigu hada ꞌeꞌahai geya sowasowahina. Coinega toꞌaha yapaihowa?
Nuwana bewa gidemusa, hada ꞌeꞌahai miyamiyadi yaleꞌwa yahuledi, ma hauhaudi ta madoudi yaꞌabidi, ma ꞌoidiya ꞌeꞌahai ta wete ꞌigu tobwatobwao mabwaiyana yahedodo,

ma muliyetega maꞌigu yaliyaya sowasowahigu ma yagwae, “Caigeda towasawasa taugu. Boꞌi yaꞌatububuwa ta ꞌigu wasawasao mabwaiyana sowasowahigu bolime hisa sinaonaoma weyahidi. Eeta paihowa ꞌoinega yaꞌaiyawasi, ma hesi tuwa yaliyayamo, weyahina ꞌagu ma ꞌagu weꞌaha mabwaiyana sowasowahigu.” ’
Ma Yehoba loheyaina ꞌoina ꞌigwaeya, ‘Loheya yauyauleiu! Hinuwana bewa yawasiu ꞌilolagu, ma tobwatobwaedi ꞌulagulagudiya, taiya nata weyahina?’”

Ma Yesu ꞌina gwae ꞌana ꞌebelolagu ꞌoina ꞌigwaeya, “Moisa, ꞌeguma taiya wasawasa weyahina ꞌipaihowa, ma ꞌimiya wasawasa tobwatobwa baleꞌuwa ꞌoidiyega, ma geya galewa ꞌana wasawasa ꞌoidiyega, tauna yauyauleina!”
Cateyoho weyahina
Coinega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena ꞌimi miya weyahina wanuwanuwatuhu madouna, ꞌamiwa ma ꞌami ꞌaleꞌo weyahidi.
Weyahina yawasida ginaula madouna mabwaiyada ꞌoida, ma tobwatobwaedi ꞌwapi weyahina geya ginaula madouna.

“Bewa ꞌaigeda ꞌebeꞌita yaꞌebwaegomi ꞌaoꞌao weyahidi, tuta baibaiwana geya sida dauna, geya sida ꞌetahiya, ma wete geya ꞌidi hada ꞌeꞌahaimo. Bwasumowedi ginaula ꞌiꞌiudi, ma tuwa Yehoba tuta baibaiwana ꞌadiwa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌebwaedi, ma hesi wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega ꞌomi ginaula madouna Yehoba ꞌoina, ꞌoinega sowasowahina ma ꞌiheꞌaigomi.
Taiya ꞌoimiyega sowasowana ꞌina nuwatuhuwega ꞌina tuta baleꞌuwa ꞌiꞌabiheduduli? Geya, ꞌawa?
Moisa tuwa, ꞌateyoho geya wete ꞌina lema ꞌoida ginaula ꞌiꞌiuna weyahina, ma toꞌaha lamuna waꞌateꞌateyoho ginaula madouna weyahidi?

“Ma ꞌaigeda wete bewa ꞌebeꞌita, hane ꞌidi bwala weyahina wanuwanuwatuhu. Tuta baibaiwana geya sida paihowa, ma wete geya ꞌadi ꞌaleꞌo sida paihowediya. Ma moisa tuwa, Solomoni ꞌana ꞌwamao ma ꞌana pasao ꞌadi ꞌita ꞌausaladi, ma hesi hane ꞌadi ꞌita ꞌausala hedadena.

Coinega wanuwanuwa Yehoba ꞌina ꞌitayahina ꞌoimiya weyahina. Tauna ꞌawata ꞌihepasediya hoyadi bwebweꞌadi ꞌoidiyega, nata sididi ma gona siwelai ma sigabudi, ma ꞌomi ꞌawata wabwebweꞌana sinediya, ꞌoinega sowasowana ꞌami ꞌwamao Yehobaina ꞌiꞌebwaegomi. Ma ꞌiyamo sahena ꞌimi hemisa Yehoba ꞌoina ꞌiweꞌaweꞌa.
“Ma weteyage sahena wanuwanuwatuhu madouna nuwana waꞌateyoho ꞌeꞌahai weyahidi.
Tomiya baleꞌu mabwaiyadi ginaulaedi weyahidi sinuwanuwatuhu, ma toꞌaha ꞌimi nuwatuhu Yehoba ꞌisanapu pwaidiya, gidemusa ꞌamiwa ta ꞌami weꞌaha ta wete ꞌami ꞌwama.
Ma ꞌilobwainegomiya nugeta Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌoina watagwalegomi, ma ꞌoinega ꞌamiwa ta ꞌami ꞌwama wete ꞌiꞌebwaegomi.
Ma ꞌomi moisa Yehoba ꞌina sipiyao, ꞌoinega sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho, weyahina tauna ꞌihesinuwa paigomiya ma ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina waluhu.

“Coinega ꞌimi tobwatobwao wahegimwaneyedi ma maneyedi waheguyaiyedi towewelohe ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌoinega galewa ꞌimi wasawasa ꞌimiya hataya. Wasawasaina galewa ꞌimiyamiya geya wete ꞌina ꞌebegumwalamo, weyahina geya ꞌaigeda wete toyagaha tupwaina ꞌoina, ma wete geya sohusohu.
Ma ꞌeguma to tupwa ꞌoina ꞌimi wasawasa ꞌimiyamiya beno ꞌoina ꞌimi nuwatuhu sipili.
Bada ꞌina hewahewaliyao tupwadi bwebweꞌadi ma tupwadi galadi
“Coinega waꞌatububu bwaibwaina ma ꞌami ꞌwamao waꞌotedi, ta wete maꞌimi mayale ꞌasiꞌasilaladi ma wayamwayamwa,
gidemusa hewahewaliyao ꞌidi bada siyamwayamwa ꞌina hilama hai ꞌeꞌahaina ꞌoinega. Ma ꞌeguma to tuta ꞌoina ꞌilatuma ma ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌoina ꞌiꞌetunatuna, dumwaluna tuwa ꞌahwaꞌedaina sisoꞌe ma ꞌiluhuma.

Ma ꞌeguma simata paꞌali ma siꞌatuꞌatububudi ma siyamwayamwa ma ꞌilobadi, nata siyaliyaya madouna. Yagwae moisa ꞌoimiya ꞌidi badaina nata ꞌwama ꞌebe paihowa ꞌiꞌote, ma hewaliyaowedi simiyatoi ma tauna weyahidi ꞌida hetopaihowa.
Ma wete ꞌeguma ꞌina tuta hilama ꞌoina ꞌiheheboi, ma hinuwana gamwana nuwana gona ꞌadaꞌadale ꞌilatuma, ma tuwa gide ꞌidi miyaina, ma ꞌilobadi, nata wete siyaliyaya madouna.
“Ma wete ginaula ꞌaigeda bewa wanuwatuhuyahi, ꞌeguma toni hada ꞌisanapuya to tuta ꞌoina toyagaha ꞌiluhuluhu ꞌina hada, nata ꞌiꞌatububu bwaibwaina ma ꞌiꞌoꞌoyatola ma sahena ꞌina hada ꞌibwalebwale.
Coinega ꞌomi wete waꞌatububu bwaibwaina ma ꞌigu tuta hilama weyahina wayamwegau, weyahina taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌigu hilama ꞌana tuta geya wasanapu.”
Coinega Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, beno taumamo weyahima ꞌugwaegwae, bo nuwana tomota mabwaiyadi weyahidi?”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Topaihowa bwebweꞌadi ma sanasanapuidi mumugadi bewa gide, ꞌeguma taiya tauna ꞌina bada ꞌihesinuwe ma hada ꞌiꞌitayahi, ma ꞌiyanao ꞌadi ꞌiꞌebwaedi sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya,
ꞌabwa ꞌeguma badaina ꞌihilama ma ꞌina topaihowa ꞌiloba ꞌipaipaihowa bwaibwaina, nata weyahina ꞌiyaliyaya ma ꞌoina ꞌigwae,
‘Cino paihowa mabwaiyana bwebweꞌana, ꞌoinega ginaula mabwaiyadi ꞌadi loina yaꞌebwaego ma ꞌuloina.’

Ma hesi ꞌeguma topaihowaina ꞌiboimo ꞌoina ꞌigwae, ‘Cigu bada ꞌabwa ꞌiheheboi, ꞌoinega taugu ꞌigu nuwatuhu yapaihowadi.’ Coinega ꞌiyanaowedi loheloheyadi ma mewahinedi ꞌisapisapidi, ma wete geya ꞌeꞌahai ꞌida ꞌebwaediya, ma ꞌiboinamo ꞌiꞌaiꞌai ma ꞌinumanuma, ma ꞌinuma yauyaule.
Ma muliyetega ꞌabwa badaina ꞌilohesalutuyama, ma ꞌina hewali ꞌina paihowa galana ꞌiꞌitaloba, nata hadega ꞌipaꞌi, ma ꞌoinega maisa gala hedadena ꞌiloba, taudi tologwahata ꞌidi tupwa.
“Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌina bada ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌisanapu ma tuwa geya ꞌiꞌatububu ta wete geya ꞌipaihowa, ꞌabwa sapi mwauna ꞌiloba.

Ta ꞌeguma taiya ꞌina bada ꞌina nuwatuhu geya ꞌisanapu, ma ꞌipaihowa pui, nata sapi ꞌiloba, ta geya madouna. Ma ꞌeguma hewali ꞌana heguheguyai madouna, ꞌilobwaineya ma ꞌina bada weyahina ꞌipaihowa madouna; ta ꞌeguma ꞌana heguheguyai madou hedada, sowasowana ꞌipaihowa madou hedada.
Yesu weyahina wataha ꞌilatuwa
“Taugu boi yatauma ma ꞌabehega ꞌaiwe yamuꞌa ꞌebwa baleꞌuwa, ta nuwanuwagu ꞌilomwayamwayau ma ꞌiꞌalata.
Ma hesi tuta ꞌiꞌiuna ma babitaiso galana yaloba, ꞌoinega maꞌigu ꞌateyoho ma ꞌana siga babitaisoina ꞌoiguwa sipaihowa.
“Ma togidega? Wanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega ꞌigu latuma baleꞌuwa ꞌoinega daumwala waloba? Geya hene. Ma hesi yahegwaegomi nata ꞌaleha ta wataha ꞌoimiya silatu.
Tutaina bewa ꞌoidiyega ma tuta sinaonaoma ꞌoidiya nata susu ꞌalodiya wataha silatu. Susuwedi ꞌalodiya ꞌeguma gidemusa tomota ꞌadi baibaiwa nima, nata ꞌalodiyega sitetoi siheꞌupwa siteluwa ꞌoidiya.

Ma wete ꞌeguma tama natuna loheyana ꞌoina ꞌiꞌaleha, nata wete natunaina tamana ꞌoina ꞌiloꞌaleha. Gidemusa wete sina ꞌeguma ꞌiloꞌaleha natuna mewahinena ꞌoina, nata wete tauna sinana ꞌiloꞌaleha. Ma wete ꞌeguma wahine ꞌiꞌaleha lawana mewahinena ꞌoina, nata lawanaina ꞌoina ꞌiheꞌupwa hila.”
Cilaꞌilala ꞌadi sanapu weyahina
Ma Yesu wete tomotaedi ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Tutaina ꞌeguma waꞌita bolimana yaloha dubadubana sihanehanema, wanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega nata ꞌidohi, beno moisa.
Ma ꞌeguma tupwa yalasi ꞌoinega yaumai ꞌitowatowama, beno ꞌoinega wasanapu pwaiya ꞌabehega tuta ꞌiꞌiuna ma hala ꞌihapwesa.
Moisa ꞌomi baleꞌu ꞌadi ꞌilaꞌilalao wasanapu pwaidiya, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌina ꞌilaꞌilalao geya wasanapudi tuta hauhauna nage weyahina. Beno ꞌimi ꞌabo.
“Ma toꞌaha lamuna ta geya wahesinuwa bwaibwaina ma ꞌeda dumwalunega watauya?

“Ma ꞌeguma ꞌa ꞌaleha ꞌinaoma ma ꞌitoego ꞌabehega ꞌiheyatalaego, ꞌilobwainegowa ma tutaina ꞌedai watautauya ꞌutoho ma galanaina ꞌupaihowa pwaiya ꞌuꞌabihedumwalu, ma ꞌoinega sahena ꞌa toheyatalaina ꞌitoetoego toloina ꞌoina, tabu ma toloinaina toloꞌalehao ꞌiloinaedi ma deliya silagugo.
Ma yahegwaego hesi sahena wete ꞌulatulatu ma ꞌana siga ꞌa buki mabwaiyana ꞌuhemaisa hegumwalidi!”
